# Voulti

> Crypto payment gateway for merchants and AI agents. Accept USDC, USDT and stablecoins on 5 networks (Celo, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, BSC) with instant self-custody settlement and a 1% fee. Public no-auth REST API: create an invoice with one POST and get a hosted checkout link; a webhook notifies you when it's paid.

Key facts:

- API base: `https://api.voulti.com` — integration endpoints require no API key or authentication.
- Typical flow: `POST /invoices` with `{ "commerce_id": "<id>", "amount_fiat": 50, "currency": "USD" }` → returns `invoice_id` → send the payer to `https://voulti.com/checkout/<invoice_id>` → poll `GET /invoices/<invoice_id>` until `status: "Paid"`, or receive the webhook on your `confirmation_url`.
- Permanent payment link per merchant: `https://voulti.com/pay/<commerce_id>?currency=USD` — payer types the amount; `currency` is optional and falls back to the merchant's account currency.
- Merchants sign up self-service at `https://app.voulti.com` (wallet or email) to get a `commerce_id`. Settlement goes to the merchant's own wallet (self-custody).
- Contracts (proxy architecture) deployed and verified on all 5 mainnets.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://voulti.com/skill.md): how an AI agent sets up payments for its human
- [Merchant dashboard](https://app.voulti.com): self-service signup, developer page with live snippets
- [Source code](https://github.com/csacanam/voulti): monorepo — checkout, merchant app, MiniPay miniapp, API, contracts

## API summary

- `POST /invoices` — create an invoice (no auth): `{ commerce_id, amount_fiat, currency, reference?, description? }`. `reference` is private to the merchant; `description` is shown to the payer. `currency` is required and chosen per invoice (USD, EUR, COP, ARS, BRL, MXN) — a merchant is not tied to one
- `GET /invoices/:id` — invoice status: `Pending`, `Paid`, `Expired`, `Refunded` (returned bare, not wrapped in `{success,data}` like POST)
- Webhook — POST to the merchant's `confirmation_url` on every final status (`Paid`, `Expired`, `Refunded`), with `invoice_id`, `amount_fiat`, `status`, `paid_tx_hash`. Signed with `X-Voulti-Signature`; **respond within ~2s** (verify the signature, ack, then do the re-check and fulfilment after responding) or the delivery is retried.
- Rate limit: 100 requests/minute per IP. Call from a server — `api.voulti.com` sends no CORS headers for third-party origins.
